purpose: Calibration/validation split for the [classifier] contribution: used only to choose the confidence floor and check the complexity conversion after the rubric was frozen on dev. Disjoint from dev and held-out by family.
source: Original synthetic cases authored for this contribution (model-authored by the contributor's AI assistant, single-pass reviewed by the same author; not independently adjudicated). No private user data. See llm-router/docs/classifier/DATASETS.md.

labels.request_type: One of code_generation, code_understanding, technical_design, analytical_reasoning, writing, factual_lookup, general (llm-router RequestType).
labels.complexity: 1 = trivial single operation; 2 = straightforward; 3 = multi-step with limited constraints; 4 = substantial reasoning or design; 5 = intricate cross-component reasoning and validation.
labels.family: Scenario family; paraphrases and near-duplicates share one and a family never spans splits.
